music.prompt: Indie dance at exactly 122 BPM for a bright product motion-graphics film: clean funky electric guitar, hand claps, warm round bass, a four-on-the-floor kick and shakers; optimistic and tidy. No vocals. It starts immediately with a calm palm-muted funky guitar riff and a shaker over a light kick (0 to 8 seconds), adds claps and a rising bass line from 8 seconds, stops for one beat at 10.5 seconds, then drops at 11 seconds into a full bright groove with open funky guitar chords that carries all the way to the end, with a lift at 23 seconds. It ends cleanly on a downbeat at 38 seconds with no big final hit and no fade.
